title: Exponential decay beyond a reciprocal scale
statement:
Let $\delta\in\mathbb R$ and $m\in\mathbb N$. If $\delta\le\tfrac12$ and $1<\delta m$, then
\[
(1-2\delta)^m\le\frac13.
\]
replaced:
For every real $\delta\le\tfrac12$ and natural number $m$ satisfying $1<\delta m$, one has
\[
 (1-2\delta)^m\le\frac13.
\]
